# Nullbox

> Nullbox is a tiny support ticket system. Customers report a problem and get a secret link to their ticket; workers answer from a shared inbox and try to reach Inbox Zero.

## Pages

- [Report a problem](/): the form that opens a new ticket. No account needed.
- [Worker inbox](/inbox): the list of tickets that still need an answer.

## API

- [Health check](/api/healthz): returns `{"status":"ok"}` when the API is up.

## Notes

- A ticket can only be read with the secret link shown once after it is created.
- The interface is available in English and Japanese.
